name: How Bad Can It Be?
source:
You have it all, a CEO position at one of the most successful companies in the nation, a beautiful and loyal girlfriend who would do anything to make you happy, a boss who took you under his wing after your father died when you were a child. But all of that can change when, unexpectedly, your boss asks you for a favor that you can't reject. The only thing left to know is "How Bad Can It Be?".

[From [url=https://doshima.itch.io/how-bad-can-it-be]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你拥有了这一切：在全国最成功的公司之一担任首席执行官，一个美丽而忠诚的女朋友，愿意做任何事情让你快乐，一个在你小时候父亲去世后将你照顾在自己羽翼之下的老板。但当你的老板出乎意料地向你提出一个你无法拒绝的请求时，这一切都可能会改变。唯一需要知道的是“它能有多糟糕？”。

[来自[url=https://doshima.itch.io/how-bad-can-it-be]Itch.io[/url]]
